SO-101: Vision-Language-Action Robotics

Manipulation research · open-source robot arm

Building and benchmarking Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies on the open-source SO-101 robotic arm. I collect teleoperated demonstrations, train imitation-learning policies, and deploy them for real-time manipulation on edge hardware, then compare a suite of state-of-the-art action models on data efficiency, generalization, and on-robot inference latency.

WHAT IS A VLA?
A Vision-Language-Action model takes camera frames plus a plain-language instruction and outputs robot actions directly, so one arm can learn new tasks from demonstrations instead of hand-coded control. Pipeline: teleoperation → LeRobot-format dataset → policy training → sim and real deployment → latency and success-rate benchmarking.

MAY 2025 → PRESENT Research · Team Lead

Off-Road Autonomous Vehicle: Hyperspectral Perception and Edge AI

Graduate Research Assistant, Team Lead · Clemson University

Lead a dual-modality perception pipeline for off-road autonomous vehicles that fuses Hyperspectral Imaging (HSI) for hazardous-object detection with RGB cameras for visual perception, integrated in a ROS2 sensor-fusion architecture and validated in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. I started on this work as a Graduate Research Assistant and was later promoted to Team Lead.

Designed a hazard-aware navigation system where HSI deep-learning outputs trigger dynamic path re-planning through Nav2, stress-tested in simulation with SLAM-based localization before real-world deployment.

Developed and deployed production-ready deep-learning models on NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, using constrained-manifold learning to reduce HSI dimensionality for baseline implementation. This motivated the development of a novel neural network that converts hyperspectral images to three-channel images. Adapted the open-source SAM2 model for real-time video segmentation to present the limitations of RGB camera.

Applied INT8 quantization with TensorRT and the Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections technique (open-source technique from DeepSeek, January 2025) to achieve a 67% reduction in model size while improving inference efficiency for real-time edge deployment.

DEC 2025 Open source

Keystroke Tracker Extension for VS Code

Open-sourced developer tool

An open-source VS Code extension that measures genuine developer activity by tracking manual keystrokes while filtering out auto-complete and copy/paste. It helps students verify manual work for academic integrity, and helps teams improve project estimation through historical keystroke and productivity metrics. Ships with persistent per-file storage, a real-time status-bar readout, and detailed per-character logging with line and column position.

LLM-Powered Conversational Assistants for Business Automation

Applied NLP · service and retail

Developed and deployed two specialized AI chatbots using GPT-4o-mini for the service and retail industries: a restaurant assistant that streamlines food ordering with a friendly, efficient experience, and a clothing-store assistant designed to gently guide customers toward on-sale items.

Gained hands-on experience with open-source models by fine-tuning Llama 3.1 8B using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and applying quantization to significantly reduce model size and optimize performance.

DEC 2024 → MAR 2025 Project

AI Agent for Atari Pac-Man: Deep Reinforcement Learning

Deep RL · GPU training

Developed a Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent for Pac-Man, using CNNs for feature extraction and experience replay for stable learning. Tuned epsilon-greedy exploration, Q-learning updates, and target-network stabilization for improved Atari performance. Implemented deep RL on GPU with PyTorch, designing an efficient memory buffer and applying policy evaluation for action selection.

OCT 2024 → DEC 2024 Project

Smart AIoT Security Surveillance

Edge computer vision · IoT response

Built a Smart AIoT security-surveillance system integrating AI and IoT for real-time threat detection and automated response. An NVIDIA Jetson Nano serves as the compute unit for AI-driven object detection with YOLOv7, detecting four classes: Person, Knife, Gun, Police Badge. Implemented MQTT-based communication for automated alerts and physical responses such as activating alarms or locking doors, with high accuracy and scalability across security applications.
